metadata.title: Hook patterns — addiction mechanisms labeled
metadata.description: A short encyclopedia of attention hooks HookLens marks on feeds: infinite scroll, badges, related rabbit holes, autoplay.

hero.title: Name the hooks that keep you scrolling
hero.description: These are attention / addiction mechanisms — not checkout dark patterns. HookLens labels them when you annotate screenshots; this page is the shared dictionary.

patterns.title: Committed hooks (v0)
patterns.label: Taxonomy
patterns.description: Same options as the Analyze annotation picker. Use these names when you mark a screenshot.

items.title: Infinite scroll
items.description: No landing, no done — the feed keeps growing. On a screenshot: box the endless list or “loading more” chrome.

items.title: Unread / inbox badge
items.description: Red counts and unread chrome that pull you back open. On a screenshot: box the badge or notification pill.

items.title: Related / continue chrome
items.description: Similar posts and continue modules that start another rabbit hole. On a screenshot: box the related rail.

items.title: Autoplay / inline video
items.description: Zero decision to continue watching. On a screenshot: box the autoplaying player or next-up strip.

items.question: Is this the same as dark-pattern detectors?
items.answer: Cousins only. Those tools hunt checkout tricks (fake timers, confirmshaming). This list is habit machinery on feeds.

items.question: Will more hooks appear here?
items.answer: Yes — ranking chrome and variable-reward drip are stretch items after the screenshot demo is solid.

cta.title: Use the dictionary in Analyze
cta.description: Pick a sample screenshot and label these hooks, then generate a report.
